patch.value: Adopt npm-package-arg 14 after the Node 22 runtime floor reaches 22.22.2

Own the npm-package-arg 14.0.0 major separately from routine dependency refreshes. Upstream requires Node ^22.22.2, ^24.15.0, or >=26 while pm currently promises >=22.18.0, so adoption would violate the supported Node 22 runtime floor.

The documented pm Node floor satisfies npm-package-arg 14 engines; Node 22/24/26 package install and source parsing tests pass; security and packed-consumer gates remain green; the major is adopted without narrowing support accidentally.
